decision_question: Are the scoped contracts suitable for analytical distribution without unsupported effectiveness claims?
acceptance_criteria: Distinct useful outcomes and composable placement
Authorization, privacy, concurrency and asset preservation boundaries
Portable resources and synthetic evaluation design

shared_model_or_source_limits: Same inherited model family and shared conversation context
No blinded independent grader or protected holdout

claim_ledger.claim: A series continuation needs prior-item state and evidence reconciliation beyond generic drafting.
claim_ledger.consequence: Unverified prior posts or results may be presented as published.
claim_ledger.next_test: Run a fresh matched continuation evaluation with an unseen case.

claim_ledger.claim: Queue revision needs separate identity, preservation and readback controls.
claim_ledger.consequence: A separate draft or wrong queue item may be mistaken for the intended post.
claim_ledger.next_test: Run a separately authorized real-host pilot with revision and asset readback.

claim_ledger.claim: These versions improve agent outcomes over a baseline or work on every host.
claim_ledger.consequence: Analytical review could be mistaken for measured effectiveness.
claim_ledger.next_test: Freeze and run matched baselines and an unseen holdout with independent grading.

initial_reviews.decision: defer until routing, timing and formatting corrections; revised contract approved with limits
defer until pre-save race correction; revised contract approved with limits

concordance: Final three roles materially agree within stated analytical limits.

falsification_hypotheses: Posting deadline crosses after editor entry while queue data remains unchanged
test_results: First timing objection survived initial written instructions; final pre-save timing gate and development case address it analytically.
Required unobservable media is marked unknown and blocks the operation; a separate development case records the expectation.

decisive_evidence: Final instruction hashes and corrected routing, timing, formatting and concurrency gates
Synthetic development cases and separately prompted role reviews
unresolved_items: No fresh matched benchmark or unseen holdout
No live scheduler-host execution of final version
Same-model reviewer correlation and non-atomic host race

limitations: Structural validation is not task-quality evidence.
Two same-model informal simulated development exercises are not an independent benchmark; the scheduler exercise predates the final revision.
Designed evaluation cases are not recorded as executed suite results.
Owner approval and host permissions remain separate from this review.

follow_up.condition: Run a frozen matched baseline and protected external holdout before claiming efficacy or uplift.
Run a separately authorized host pilot and record conditional-write availability and preservation coverage.
Repeat review on a material contract, host, authorization-policy or evidence change.
